-- AAC Phase 1B
-- Test configuration is intentionally embedded here for the POC:
--   campaign_id: campaign_2026_09_poc
--   doctor_id:   doctor_test_001
--   base URL:    https://content.apexdp.com/interview/
--   expiration:  30 days
--
-- Only the SHA-256 hash of each raw token is persisted in BigQuery.
-- The raw token is returned only in this execution output so it can
-- later be delivered to the doctor.

CREATE TEMP TABLE generated_links AS
SELECT
  GENERATE_UUID() AS link_id,
  t.campaign_id,
  'doctor_test_001' AS doctor_id,
  t.topic_id,
  CONCAT(
    REPLACE(GENERATE_UUID(), '-', ''),
    REPLACE(GENERATE_UUID(), '-', '')
  ) AS raw_token,
  CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS created_at,
  TIMESTAMP_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AS expires_at,
  t.topic_sort_order,
  t.topic_title,
  t.topic_description,
  t.interview_guidance
FROM
  `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.campaign_topics` t
JOIN
  `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.campaign_doctors` cd
    ON cd.campaign_id = t.campaign_id
   AND cd.doctor_id = 'doctor_test_001'
WHERE
  t.campaign_id = 'campaign_2026_09_poc'
  AND t.active = TRUE;

ASSERT (
  SELECT COUNT(*) FROM generated_links
) = 3
AS 'Expected exactly three active campaign topics for this doctor.';

UPDATE
  `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.interview_links`
SET
  status = 'SUPERSEDED'
WHERE
  campaign_id = 'campaign_2026_09_poc'
  AND doctor_id = 'doctor_test_001'
  AND status IN ('READY', 'OPENED')
  AND used_at IS NULL;

INSERT INTO
  `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.interview_links`
(
  link_id,
  campaign_id,
  doctor_id,
  topic_id,
  secure_token_hash,
  status,
  created_at,
  expires_at,
  first_opened_at,
  used_at,
  interview_id
)
SELECT
  link_id,
  campaign_id,
  doctor_id,
  topic_id,
  TO_HEX(SHA256(raw_token)),
  'READY',
  created_at,
  expires_at,
  NULL,
  NULL,
  NULL
FROM
  generated_links;

INSERT INTO
  `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.workflow_events`
(
  event_id,
  entity_type,
  entity_id,
  event_type,
  event_timestamp,
  source_system,
  workflow_execution_id,
  payload
)
SELECT
  GENERATE_UUID(),
  'campaign_doctor',
  'campaign_2026_09_poc:doctor_test_001',
  'interview.links_generated',
  CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(),
  'n8n',
  NULL,
  TO_JSON(
    STRUCT(
      'campaign_2026_09_poc' AS campaign_id,
      'doctor_test_001' AS doctor_id,
      COUNT(*) AS link_count
    )
  )
FROM
  generated_links;

SELECT
  c.campaign_name,
  d.doctor_name,
  p.practice_name,
  g.topic_sort_order,
  g.topic_id,
  g.topic_title,
  g.topic_description,
  g.interview_guidance,
  g.link_id,
  CONCAT(
    'https://content.apexdp.com/interview/',
    g.raw_token
  ) AS interview_url,
  g.expires_at,
  'READY' AS link_status
FROM
  generated_links g
JOIN
  `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.campaigns` c
    ON c.campaign_id = g.campaign_id
JOIN
  `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.doctors` d
    ON d.doctor_id = g.doctor_id
JOIN
  `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.practices` p
    ON p.practice_id = d.practice_id
ORDER BY
  g.topic_sort_order;

## AAC Phase 1B - Corrected

This POC intentionally uses only two executable nodes to maximize import compatibility:

**Manual Trigger → BigQuery**

After import:
1. Open **Generate and Store Three Secure Links**.
2. Select your existing Google BigQuery service-account credential.
3. Execute the workflow.

The BigQuery node itself should return the three topic-specific links.

The `content.apexdp.com` URLs remain placeholders until the interview web app exists.
